title: fix(app-shell): an edit a Studio pillar holds unsent guards departure like a dirty pillar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8WL2sva4QpvpyNanwaBxGsw)_

Fixes #26705

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 把「暂存未发的编辑」(还不能保存的字段、步骤、组件)也算作未保存工作;离开支柱、刷新页面、在左侧栏切换到别的对象/流程/页面时,会先弹出与 Access 相同的确认框。
- 为什么改:之前 Data、Automations、Interfaces 支柱暂存的编辑只拦发布,不拦离开,一次误点就静默丢失;分诊裁决是「confirm 加 beforeunload,共用一个守卫」。
- 风险与回滚:只多问一句,不改保存与发布逻辑;暂存与否沿用已有判定。有问题直接 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里的 `confirmDropUnsavedWork` 和 `unsavedPillarWork`,然后三处左侧栏 onClick / onPick 的守卫行,最后 `StudioDesignSurface.heldDataLeave-26705.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.heldDataLeave-26705.test.tsx`,预期 4 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Base `607d3bb1`, then `origin/main` `55b5042e` merged in (no conflict; nothing it brought touches these files). Then `d33bfcf7`: the zh catalogue preload in two metadata-admin suites (test-only, scope widened by the seat, Claim 6452362760). One shared guard, read by every departure that drops a pillar's buffer:

- **`confirmDropUnsavedWork(unsaved, locale)`**, a module function beside `useHeldEditReport`: the one question (`engine.edit.unsavedLeaveConfirm`, the text Access already asks) or `true` when nothing would be lost. Access's own `confirmDiscardEdits` now calls it too, so the question has one spelling.
- **Surface:** `heldEdit` moves up beside `pillarDirty`, and `unsavedPillarWork = pillarDirty || heldEdit !== null` replaces `pillarDirty` in `confirmLeavePillar`, the `beforeunload` effect and `useRegisterUnsavedEdits`. That covers the pillar links (the shell seam's link guard asks while registered), Home, the package switcher, the cross-pillar `?surface=` request, Create app, the shell's own departures and reload. Pillars already take their held report back on unmount, so a confirmed leave clears the guard.
- **Rail item switch** (a pillar-local path the surface cannot see; another item's load replaces the one buffer the held edit lives in): the Data object rail asks on `objHeld`, the Automations flow rail on `flowHeld`, the Interfaces nav rail on `leafHeld`. Re-picking the open item (same object, same flow, an entry for the same leaf) drops nothing and asks nothing, mirroring Access's rail.
- Unchanged by design: how a held edit is judged and saved, and Publish's refusal while one is held.

## Why

Triage first grade on the card, verbatim: "Guard departure the way the Access pillar and the Interfaces navigation already do (confirm plus `beforeunload`), with one shared guard." A held edit lives only in the pillar's buffer, so before this change one stray click dropped a half-added field, step or widget that the strip had just promised was "kept here".

## Tests

Three new files, one per pillar, each through the real `StudioDesignSurface` on the real route shape (the held edit is produced the way an author does it: a Picklist with no option, a Notify step with no Title, a Metric widget with no dataset):

- `StudioDesignSurface.heldDataLeave-26705.test.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.heldFlowLeave-26705.test.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.heldWidgetLeave-26705.test.tsx`, four cases each: leaving the pillar asks (Cancel keeps the held edit, OK leaves, and walking back asks nothing); the rail switch asks (Cancel keeps it, re-picking the open item asks nothing, OK opens the other item and the hold is gone); a reload asks only once the edit is held; and the CONTROL: with nothing held, the rail, the reload and the pillar link never ask.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- New files: 3 files, 12/12 passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ packages/app-shell/src/chrome/`: 244 files, 1773/1773 passed, exit 0 (pre-merge head `d2e66f47`).
- After merging `origin/main`: the three new files plus `pillarNavGuard`, `heldPublish-11786`, `heldWidgetPublish-11910`, re-run on the merge head `b8d23d79`: 6 files, 28/28 passed, exit 0.
- Two metadata-admin suites, `ResourceEditPage.discardDraftLabel-12690` and `PackageFormDialog.validationTiming`, now load the zh studio catalogue at module scope (`await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`), as other zh-reading suites do since the studio namespace became lazy (#25922). The first went red on `Test UI` at `0a856a7d`. With the zh catalogue held back 4 s, each is red without its preload (1/3, 3/5) and green with it (3/3, 5/5).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each leg restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

- Leg A, drop the held term from the surface (`unsavedPillarWork = pillarDirty`): 6 of 12 red, exactly the leave and reload cases of all three pillars; the rail and control cases stay green.
- Leg B, drop the held term from each rail guard (replace `objHeld !== null` / `flowHeld !== null` / `leafHeld !== null` with `false`): each pillar's rail-switch case red (1 of 4 per file), nothing else.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not guarded, measured and left as they were: creating a new object, flow or Interfaces item while another item's edit is held opens the new item (the create has already been written), and a same-pillar `?surface=` request from the pending-changes sheet opens the requested item without asking. Both drop the held edit the same way a rail switch did. The card names leaving the pillar, the rail switch and reload; these two are left for a follow-up if wanted.
- Browser Back/Forward is still not vetoed, as the shell seam's docblock already states for every page.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so no changeset.

## Verification

Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 24 families, all run, reconciled with `--ran` (24 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` reported one timeout in `check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` (15 s, shared box under load) and passed 83/83 when that file was re-run alone. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the four files: 0 errors; `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` carries the same 16 warnings as on the base, the three tests none.)

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `@object-ui/app-shell` is private.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
